xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex75012023-09-28-091757" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (121a8-9) p. 245:8-0 (printed: IMG 455, p. 343)"/><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5197"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3711"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706"><expan>shes rab</expan> kyi <expan>pha rol</expan> tu phyin pa'i <expan>man ngag gi</expan> <expan>bstan bcos</expan> ¦ <expan>mngon par</expan> <expan>rtogs</expan> pa'i rgyan</rs> gyi 'grel pa</rs> don gsal gyi <expan>rnam par</expan> bshad pa mi phaM dgongs pa'i rgyan</rs> zhes bya ba 'di | bde bar <expan>gshegs pa'i</expan> gsung rab kyi dgongs <expan>pa'i</expan> don rnaM par 'byed pa la rnaM dpyod kyi skal ba gzhan las  <lb n="121a9"/> mi dman par gyur pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5198">shAkya'i dge slong <expan>blo gros</expan> rgya mtsho</rs> zhes bya bas mkhas grub du ma'i 'byung gnas <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6173"><expan>dpal ldan</expan> gsang phu ne'u <expan>thog gi gtsug</expan> lag khang</rs> du sbyar ba rdzogs+ho ||</seg></TEI>
